$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (gateway-api-design-rules-check, decisions D3 and D4). Adds `api_design_ruleset` (an organisation's own rule set in the built-in format; the Dutch API design rules ship as a file, lib/Settings/api-design-rules/) and `api_design_finding` (one failed rule of one product version, open or waived with a reason). A check replaces the open findings of a product version and keeps the waived ones whose rule and path still match. Seeds the custom rule set `gemeente-voorbeeld`.

api_design_ruleset.title: API design rule set
api_design_ruleset.description: A set of rules an API product's OpenAPI description is checked against. Same format as the built-in Dutch API design rules.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the rule set, shown on every finding it produces.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version of the rules this set follows.

source.title: Source
source.description: Built-in sets ship with integriq; custom sets are the organisation's own.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Rules: id, title, severity (error, warning, info), given (a JSONPath selector), then (truthy, falsy, pattern, enum, casing, schema or length), url, or manual: true for a rule a person checks.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Only enabled rule sets are checked.

api_design_finding.title: API design finding
api_design_finding.description: One failed rule of one API product version: open, or waived by an administrator with a reason.

product.title: Product
product.description: The api_product this finding belongs to.

productVersion.title: Product version
productVersion.description: The product version that was checked.

ruleset.title: Rule set
ruleset.description: Name of the rule set the rule belongs to.

ruleId.title: Rule
ruleId.description: The rule id, for the Dutch rules the Logius rule id.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Error-level findings that are open hold back publication.

path.title: Path
path.description: JSON pointer into the checked document.

url.title: Rule text
url.description: Link to the text of the rule.

status.title: Status
status.description: Open, or waived by an administrator with a reason.

waivedBy.title: Waived by
waivedBy.description: User id of the administrator who waived the finding.

checkedAt.title: Checked at
checkedAt.description: When the check that produced it ran.
